Implemented the meetup scheduler in [meetup.h](/app/meetup.h) and [meetup.cpp](/app/meetup.cpp).

It supports:

- Teenth weekdays
- First, second, third, and fourth weekdays
- Last weekdays
- All seven weekdays
- Leap years and month boundaries via Boost Gregorian dates
